objective: Expand development-only signed-benefit coverage after v1 produced only one positive-direction context.
hypothesis: Motion- and gripper-transition-stratified replay starts contain at least one additional locality-admitted positive-benefit history-correction context.
selection_reason: V1 froze eight starts and returned class counts {-1: 2, 0: 5, +1: 1}. This second immutable batch targets untested action phases while retaining episode and start diversity; it is combined with v1 only by a hash-bound admission settlement.
falsification_criterion: Keep training blocked if the combined v1 and v2 frozen selectors still contain fewer than two contexts in any signed-benefit class. Do not synthesize, relabel, or tune the confidence threshold after execution.
artifact_policy: Retain every context result, log, zero-dose video, input hash, merge receipt, atlas, selector, and combined settlement. Never overwrite an existing output directory.

protocol.threshold_freeze_timing: Inherited unchanged from v1 and frozen before all v2 context jobs launch.

probe_paths.transformation: apply fixed gain d through h_i'=h_i+d*(current-h_i) using the exact norm-bounded FSHC operator

data_admission_gate.fail_action: Do not train the multiscale candidate; expand development probes or return to mechanism redesign.

claim_scope: Second-batch development-only paired-dose class discovery. It is not repair-effect or promotion evidence.
